sql.query: SELECT COALESCE(w.contractingEntityId,(SELECT ce.id FROM tbl_contracting_entities ce WHERE ce.tenantId=w.tenantId AND ce.isDefault=1 AND ce.isActive=1 LIMIT 1)) contractingEntityId FROM tbl_workflows w WHERE w.id=:workflowId AND w.tenantId=:tenantId AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM tbl_user_tenant_roles utr WHERE utr.userId=:userId AND utr.tenantId=w.tenantId AND utr.isActive=1) LIMIT 1
